the minority population is growing at an extremely rapid rate, that the population of the minorities is young, and that the minority population has a higher level of educational attainment than the Han population.

the Chinese minorities are younger than the Han majority, are more concentrated in rural areas than are the Han majority, have higher fertility than the Han majority (although fertility is decreasing among most of the groups), and are less educated than the Han majority.

China’s ethnic minorities are younger than the Han majority population, have higher fertility, higher mortality, lower life expectancy at birth, lower literacy, lower educational attainment, lower per capita incomes, and are more likely to be engaged in agriculture and in the informal sector of the economy.
